items.event: Presidents Cup — USA vs Internationals at Medinah
items.line: Scottie Scheffler's USA, winners of 10 straight Presidents Cups, host a stacked International side (Matsuyama, Tom Kim, Sungjae Im, Adam Scott) at Medinah. Four-ball matches open the four-day team event.

items.event: Laver Cup — Team Europe vs Team World
items.line: Alcaraz and Zverev lead Europe against Fritz, Shelton and De Minaur's Team World at the O2 Arena, with Europe trying to reclaim the title after last year's 15-9 loss in San Francisco. No team can clinch before the final day.
